method: Human-model visual inspection of every final 115dpi Poppler page PNG after the latest PDF build.
checks: All seven latest pages viewed individually; no clipping or overlapping text/tables.
All six paired C points and both receiver means retained; seed labels separated.
All eighteen 200-epoch trajectories visible; axes, legends and captions readable.
A factorial, simple-effect and all-layer geometry tables match saved aggregates.
Native TF32 failure, C threshold failure and seed202 gap counterexample visibly retained.
LaTeX build has no overflow, missing-glyph or unresolved-reference warnings.
